description: Source code for a Kubernetes controller managing the NonStructuralSchema condition for CustomResourceDefinitions, including logic for calculating, updating, and synchronizing conditions based on CRD schemas.

classes.name: ConditionController
classes.description: Controller for maintaining the NonStructuralSchema condition on CRDs, including event handling, condition calculation, and status updates.

methods.name: calculateCondition
methods.description: Calculates the NonStructuralSchema condition for a given CRD based on its schema validation.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the CRD condition state with the current schema validation status.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the controller with specified number of workers and stop channel.

methods.name: RunWithContext
methods.description: Starts the controller with context support, allowing graceful shutdown.

methods.name: runWorker
methods.description: Processes items from the work queue.

methods.name: processNextWorkItem
methods.description: Handles a single work item from the queue.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a CRD object to the work queue for processing.

methods.name: addCustomResourceDefinition
methods.description: Handles add events for CRDs, enqueuing the object.

methods.name: updateCustomResourceDefinition
methods.description: Handles update events for CRDs, enqueuing the object.

methods.name: deleteCustomResourceDefinition
methods.description: Handles delete events for CRDs, removing from lastSeenGeneration map.
